name: Vanishing Strike (Su)
body:
Prerequisite(s): Magus 6

Benefit(s): The magus can expend 1 point from his arcane pool as a swift action to enable a latent magical effect. Upon striking with a successful melee attack within 1 minute of activating this ability, the magus becomes immediately invisible for 1 round per level. The effect immediately ends if the magus attacks any creature.
